## Summary

Describe the formula, verification, CI, or documentation change.

## Verification

- [ ] Version and release tag are verified.
- [ ] `release-manifest.json` is verified.
- [ ] `SHA256SUMS` is verified.
- [ ] All four Homebrew target archives and hashes are verified.
- [ ] Formula style passed.
- [ ] External-tap formula audit passed.
- [ ] Native install and formula test passed where the platform was available.
- [ ] Uninstall and reinstall passed where the platform was available.
- [ ] Unsigned-preview wording was reviewed.
- [ ] No binaries or downloaded archives are committed.
- [ ] No private source links or credentials are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.

## Native coverage

List the operating systems and architectures tested natively. Identify targets
that received structural and release-contract verification only.

## Limitations

Record any untested native architecture or other known limitation. Do not
claim a true cross-version upgrade test until a second CLI release exists.
